result.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

Nautilus Aviation (as part of Morris Aviation) is a proven helicopter specialist with over 25 years flying experience and has grown to become one of Australia’s premier helicopter operators. Today our network of bases spans Cairns, Port Douglas, Townsville, Darwin, Jabiru, Gove and Torres Strait (Horn Island).

Nautilus Aviation has recently expanded its operations into southern Australia with the acquisition of Heli Surveys (including Snowy Mountains Helicopters), based in Jindabyne NSW in the heart of the Snowy Mountains.

We are now seeking a Senior Base Engineer to lead the maintenance operations at the Heli Surveys home base in Jindabyne.

This is an outstanding opportunity for a suitably qualified Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (LAME) with extensive helicopter experience who is looking for a rewarding career combined with an exceptional outdoor lifestyle.

We have a full-time position available for a highly experienced LAME. There is a variety of roster types and flexibility available for negotiation. As part of the role, you may be required to undertake short duration trips to alternate bases in support of our dynamic and varied fleet (including the Heli Surveys remote bases in Lakes Entrance, Victoria and Victor Harbor, South Australia).

As the Senior Base Engineer (LAME) for Heli Surveys as part of Nautilus Aviation, you will be responsible for ensuring aircraft are maintained to the highest standards of safety and airworthiness while working closely with our Chief Engineer and Head of Airworthiness & Maintenance Control (HAAMC), based in North Queensland.

The Senior Base Engineer (LAME) will be charged with:

-  Overseeing all maintenance and servicing on the fleet of AS350/H125, Bell 407, Bell 212 and Bell 412 helicopters
-  Certifying for line and heavy maintenance on the fleet of AS350/H125, Bell 407, Bell 212 and Bell 412 helicopters both at home base and in remote locations when required
-  Certifying for defect rectifications / rectifying breakdowns on our AS350/H125, Bell 407, Bell 212 and Bell 412 fleet both at home base and at remote locations as required
-  Leading and supervising all other LAME's, AME's and Apprentices on a day to day basis in carrying out maintenance on company aircraft
-  Ensuring all aircraft maintenance is certified and complied with in accordance with company procedures
-  Communicating with the company Chief Engineer and Head of Airworthiness & Maintenance Control (HAAMC) and operations to ensure all stakeholders are informed of current status of all aircraft

BENEFITS:

Working as a Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Engineer for Heli Surveys and Morris Group will include:

-  Relocation assistance to the right candidate
-  Competitive remuneration package
-  Opportunity to work across a diverse fleet of helicopters
-  Work on a varied range of rotary wing aircraft
-  Staff discounts on helicopter charters and training
-  Winter ski season pass
-  Summer mountain biking season pass
-  Exclusive employee discounts across the Morris Group's hospitality, tourism and leisure businesses
-  Career development opportunities across Heli Surveys, Nautilus Aviation and the wider Morris Group

REQUIREMENTS:

To be successful in this role as a Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Engineer, you must have:

-  The right to live and work in Australia (visa sponsorship may be considered for the right candidate)
-  Valid Australian Driver’s license
-  CASA-recognised Aircraft Maintenance Engineer qualifications
-  CASA recognised qualifications/licence : B412 and/or B212
-  Experience maintaining AS350/H125 helicopters
-  Experience maintaining Bell helicopters
-  Leadership and management skills
-  Ability to lead a team of LAME's, AME's, Apprentices and other staff
-  Excellent verbal and written communication skills
-  Computer literacy with experience on aircraft computer aided maintenance systems
-  Strong organisational skills
-  The ability to prioritise workloads and manage competing demands
-  The ability to work both independently and as part of a team
-  A proactive, self-motivated approach
-  A strong commitment to a safe work environment and legal/regulatory compliance
-  Positive and professional attitude
-  Current ASIC and Human Factors qualifications (or ability to obtain/renew with company assistance)

Desirable:

-  Preference will be given to candidates with experience in AS350/H125, Bell 407, Bell 212/412 and Robinson R44 helicopters
-  Experience with other helicopters including EC130, 505, Bell 407 / 206L / 206A/B
-  Experience using Computer Maintenance and Management Systems – Aerotrack MRO(Aust) and Air Maestro will be an advantage
-  Forklift ticket

ABOUT US:

With more than 25 years of operational experience, Heli Surveys has established itself as one of Australia's leading utility helicopter operators. As part of the Morris Group and sister company to Nautilus Aviation, we operate from a network of bases including Cairns, Port Douglas, Townsville, Darwin, Jabiru, Gove, Horn Island and Jindabyne.

Our fleet supports a wide variety of utility operations throughout Australia, providing our engineers with diverse and interesting work in a dynamic environment.

Nautilus Aviation has built an outstanding reputation based on the quality and diversity of our fleet of helicopters and our commitment to the safety of all passengers and personnel at all times.

We pride ourselves on our customer service from the delivery of commercial air work, pilot training, Search & Rescue and chartered flights all while working in partnership with a number of top tourism operators to deliver leisure experiences over some of the iconic natural landscapes of Australia.

Nautilus Aviation and Heli Surveys are part of the Morris Group of companies. Morris Group is an independent, family-run business that was founded in 1980 and operates a collection of iconic Australian experiences. With businesses in tourism, hospitality, aviation, and technology, we’re on a mission to make a positive impact doing work we love. From luxury resorts and lodges to urban beer gardens, elevated dining experiences, and super-yacht adventures; everything we do is inspired by our love for good company and the great outdoors.

In addition to Nautilus Aviation, Morris Group also owns and operates a collection of hotels and luxury lodges in Queensland as part of Morris Escapes – including Beechmont Estate, Orpheus Island Lodge, Pelorus Island and Mt Mulligan Lodge. Morris Group is also the owner of the world-class holiday destinations The Ville Resort-Casino and Ardo Hotel, both located in Townsville QLD.

Morris Group also includes Morris Hospitality that focuses on creating elevated dining experiences with venues including the Albert Park Hotel, Portsea Hotel, Railway Club Hotel, O’Connell’s, Half Moon and the Lucky Coq in Victoria, the Julatten Hotel in Queensland and CBCo Brewing in Victoria and Western Australia.

If you excel at delivering world class service and have experience as a Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Engineer, we want to hear from you!

At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers.
A fantastic opportunity to be part of a team that focuses on cutting-edge technology and quality engineering principles.
Full-time and permanent position based at our new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide. 


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help us ensure consumer needs are met by embedding robust testing strategies and automation practices that uphold software reliability, performance, and security. Deliver seamless, high-quality digital experiences that build customer trust and satisfaction.



As a Senior Quality Engineer – Conversational AI, you’ll be responsible for testing and validating chatbot solutions while helping shape and evolve our CAI quality engineering capability. You’ll work closely with product, engineering and AI teams to design automated chatbot tests, validate conversation flows, and troubleshoot issues as they arise. With the freedom to identify and implement the best solutions, you’ll continuously improve our tools, frameworks and overall approach to CAI testing.



You’ll Have

Strong experience in Quality Engineering or QA, with hands-on experience testing Conversational AI or chatbot platforms
Proven experience using Cyara Botium for chatbot test automation
Expertise in testing conversation flows, intents, entities and dialogue management across multiple scenarios
Experience validating chatbot integrations with backend systems and APIs
Ability to design and execute end-to-end test strategies for AI-driven customer experiences
Experience embedding chatbot testing into CI/CD pipelines
Strong understanding of the challenges of testing AI systems, including ambiguity, edge cases and training data validation
Experience testing non-functional requirements such as performance, security and accessibility in conversational interfaces
Confidence collaborating with cross-functional teams to embed quality early in the delivery lifecycle
Strong analytical skills to interpret chatbot behaviour and translate insights into quality improvements
Excellent communication, documentation and stakeholder engagement skills
Experience working with Mobile apps as the entry point to the chat bot.
A continuous improvement mindset and passion for emerging AI technologies
Confidence contributing to go/no-go decisions for chatbot and CAI releases


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger. 

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers. 

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless. 


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.  

We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan. 

Apply at the earliest to be considered!

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

result.description:
About Us
The AHB Group is one of Australia’s largest and fastest-growing residential building companies, ranked #1 builder in Victoria and among the top builders nationally. Since 2005, our team has helped thousands of families realise their dream of home ownership through our diverse portfolio of brands including Sherridon Homes, Royston Homes and more.

We are now seeking an experienced Structural & Civil Engineer to join our engineering team at our Derrimut head office.
This is a full-time permanent role working Monday to Friday, 8.30 am to 5.00 pm, with one day of WFH flexibility.

The Opportunity
You will play a key role in the structural design of diverse developments, producing construction documentation, and providing on-site technical support from design through to construction completion.

This is a hands-on technical role involving a mix of design office work and site visits across metropolitan Melbourne and regional Victoria. You will collaborate closely with internal teams including construction, pre-construction, and project management to ensure smooth project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
1.	Carry out structural design and analysis for reinforced concrete and steel structures, including advanced load modelling and member capacity assessments
2.	Produce detailed construction drawings, engineering specifications, and structural calculation reports
3.	Conduct site inspections during construction to verify design compliance and provide practical technical guidance to resolve on-site issues such as design-to-site variances, alternative material approvals, and staging complexities
4.	Design foundations and retaining walls, integrating geotechnical findings for various soil conditions
5.	Review and assess shop drawings, connection details, and construction methodology submitted by subcontractors and suppliers
6.	Coordinate with architects, project managers, building surveyors, and other disciplines to ensure design alignment and timely project delivery
7.	Prepare technical documentation for tender submissions and project proposals

About You
Essential Criteria
1.	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline
2.	Minimum 5 years of experience in structural design and analysis, with demonstrated expertise in reinforced concrete and steel structures
3.	Proficiency in AutoCAD for producing engineering drawings and documentation
4.	Strong capability in structural analysis and finite element software such as SAP2000, ABAQUS, ETABS, or equivalent advanced tools
5.	Solid understanding of structural design principles with the ability to apply relevant Australian Standards (AS 3600, AS 4100, AS 1170 series) or equivalent international design codes
6.	Experience in seismic design, structural dynamics, or handling complex/large-scale building projects
7.	Proven ability to provide on-site construction support and resolve technical challenges during the building phase
8.	Current valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel to project sites

Desirable Criteria
1.	Master’s degree in Structural Engineering or a related field
2.	Solid understanding of footing design for reactive soils (AS 2870) and Australian residential building methods, including timber framing systems
3.	Familiarity with BIM workflows and software such as Revit
4.	Registration or eligibility for registration as a Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) with Engineers Australia
5.	Experience preparing structural reports and documentation for award-winning or high-profile projects

Why Join Us?
1.	Join Victoria’s #1 volume builder
2.	Competitive salary of $100,000 – $130,000 + super with annual performance reviews
3.	One day WFH flexibility
4.	Work with a collaborative and supportive team
5.	Genuine career progression opportunities within a growing business
6.	Pathways for professional accreditation and career development
7.	Onsite parking
8.	Team lunches and lunch-time walks
9.	Legendary company events

If you have the skillset and more importantly the drive to contribute to one of Australia’s fastest-growing building companies, then we would recommend you apply today and our team will be in touch with you.

As a market leader, AHB Group can offer a variety of progression within the company for the excelling employee, why not take the opportunity and meet with us.

Apply online today with your CV and cover letter.

Applicants must have full working rights in Australia or be eligible to obtain the relevant visa to work in Australia.

AHB Group is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background.
